{{Quote|Vigilance, community, defense.|Citizens' Militia motto|<ref name="BtC" />}}
The '''Citizens' Militia''' was the [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|security force]] and [[Militia/Legends|militia]] of several cities and outposts on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was led by a [[Sheriff/Legends|sheriff]] and included [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] and [[Constable/Legends|constables]]. However, the militia focused more on defending Anchorhead from outside raiders and was not as adept at actual crime solving.

The [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] branch of the militia was known as the '''Anchorhead militia'''.

==History==
{{GameLSmechanics|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
===Policing Anchorhead===
{{Quote|Have you seen the militia around here? Part-time farmers and half-trained boys. But we're doing our best.|Sheriff Encot to Republic heroes|<ref name="SR">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]|Smuggler's Route|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>}}
In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="3643BBY">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] [[Sheriff/Legends|Sheriff]] [[Encot]] sought assistance from four Republic heroes<ref name="Heroes">Throughout this article, the term "Republic heroes" is used to signify the four playable classes of the Republic faction in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. This includes the [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]], [[The Barsen'thor|Jedi Consular]], [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|Republic Trooper]], and [[Voidhound|Smuggler]].</ref> to shut down a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] trading operation in the [[City/Legends|city]] run by the [[Twin Suns (pirates)|Twin Suns]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. His only lead was their connection to a separate [[Droid/Legends|droid]] smuggling operation run out of a [[Anchorhead Eastern Warehouse|warehouse]] in the eastern part of the city. The heroes pursued the lead, eventually discovering the slaver operation being run out of Hangar 21 of the city's [[Anchorhead Spaceport|spaceport]]. To permanently shut down the slave ring, the heroes eliminated at least fifteen Twin Suns pirates<ref name="SDtST">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Shut Down the Slave Trade|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> along with their slavemaster and kidnappers and freed the captured slaves. Sheriff Encot promised to dispatch the militia to hold the hangar to prevent the operation from restarting.<ref name="SR" />

After local [[Magistrate/Legends|magistrate]] [[Ledo Melnic]] dispatched local [[Security officer/Legends|security officers]] to stop [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] from harassing local [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]], the Mandalorians began fortifying an old storage facility in the city into a base to launch attacks on local militia security forces from. The Republic heroes destroyed four Mandalorian munitions stockpiles in the old facility<ref name"D">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Disarmament|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> while defeating at least twelve Mandalorians including their leader, [[Rhigoth]], to spare Anchorhead from future attacks.<ref name="DtH">{{TORcite|type=heroic|Down the Hole|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>

After advanced police surveillance [[Holocamera/Legends|holocams]] were stolen by the very [[Thief/Legends|thieves]] they were intended to help catch, militia [[Constable/Legends|Constable]] [[Bakishan]] appealed to the Republic heroes for assistance. Bakishan's sole lead was witness testimony that prior to each theft, two [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] were seen in the area. The heroes destroyed worn-out astromechs until they recovered a remote control device leading them to the droids' controller, a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] named [[Izink]]. The heroes recovered the holocams and returned them to Bakishan.<ref name="A">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]|Astromenace|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>

===Outpost Salara missions===
At [[Outpost Salara]] in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]], Militiaman [[Tonn]] encouraged the Republic heroes to assist [[Raith Bannik]], a local hero known for stealing back supplies taken by the Twin Suns, whose "loved ones" had been kidnapped by the pirate gang. The heroes proceeded to the nearby [[Twin Suns mining compound|mining compound]] recently seized by the pirates and, to strike a major blow to the gang, defeated at least twenty pirates,<ref name="QQ1">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Stage 1 - Quarry Quandary|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> sabotaged four mining carts to inhibit their flow of resources,<ref name="QQ2">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Stage 2 - Quarry Quandary|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> disabled their [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] to prevent them from shipping stolen goods offworld,<ref name="QQ3">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Stage 3 - Quarry Quandary|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> and defeated [[Garthrus|"Eclipse-Maker" Garthrus]], the Twin Suns' mining operations leader, and seized the gang's smuggling data off his body. <ref name="QQF">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Final Stage - Quarry Quandary|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> The heroes discovered that Bannik's "loved ones" were in fact merely a collection of well-kept miniature toy droids, which they returned to him.<ref name="PfT">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]|Penalty for Theft|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>

Constable [[Surall]] warned the heroes that native [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]] were taking potshots at travelers in the [[Jundland Chasm/Legends|chasm]] headed to the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] and asked them to seize the natives' [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifles]]. The heroes defeated at least ten Sand People<ref name="SS">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Steady Shot|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> and delivered five of the rifles to Surall.<ref name="TP">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]|Target Practice|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>

===Outpost Thorazan missions===
{{Quote|People are going soft here. Look around--not one of these idiots here has stepped forward to join the militia to defend our towns.|Militiaman Lapad Dula to Republic heroes|<ref name="TLG">{{TORcite|type=heroic|The Long Goodbye|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>}}
From [[Outpost Thorazan]] in the Dune Sea, militia [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Lem Trudo]] feared the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] would turn its attention to local Tatooine settlements after their [[Reclamation Service Tatooine expedition|excavations]] had concluded. He contrived a plan to distract the Imperials by forcing them to confront a vicious local tribe of Sand People instead. The empire was [[Poison/Legends|poisoning]] the tribe's [[Water/Legends|water]] [[Water well|wells]] at the [[Motesta Oasis/Legends|Motesta Oasis]], so Trudo supplied the Republic heroes with an [[Antidote/Legends|antidote]] they used on three of the well's [[Water purifier|purifiers]], thus preserving the tribe and reigniting their attacks on the Imperials.<ref name="CLWE">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]|Can't Live With 'Em|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>

Militia [[Chief of Security/Legends|Security Chief]] [[Barret]] alerted the heroes that the Mandalorians were preparing to raid the outpost. As a preemptive measure, Barret suggested the heroes strike the Mandalorian camp and take down the [[Unidentified Mandalorian leader (Tatooine)|warlord]] leading them to thwart the attack. The heroes defeated ten Mandalorians and sabotaged their [[Starship/Legends|starship]], drawing out and defeating the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]], thus preserving the outpost from attack.<ref name="PS">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]|Pre-emptive Strike|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>

After a fifteen-man militia patrol was kidnapped by the forces of [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] warlord [[Takor|Takor the Terrible]], militiaman [[Lapad Dula]] directed the heroes to the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]]<ref name="SWTORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> where his men had been fed to the resident [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]]. The heroes defeated Takor<ref name="TtT">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Takor the Terrible|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> along with twenty of his Gamorrean followers and used a poison [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]] on the sarlacc to end the suffering of the militiamen.<ref name="TLG" />

===Espelar missions===
{{Quote|We call ourselves a militia, but we let those Sand People walk all over us.|Militiaman Jerol Nex to Republic heroes|<ref name="ToR">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]|Trail of Ruin|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>}}
Before departing Tatooine, the Republic heroes were asked by former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Galen Besk]] to remain on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to assist the locals in uniting against the empire.<ref name="FtF">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]|Forge the Future|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> Their efforts began first at the [[Camp Karnori|Espelar]] settlement where, at the request of local militia leader [[Junter Galt]], the heroes took militiaman [[Vastil]] and his [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of recruits on a training exercise by patrolling [[Farm/Legends|farmsteads]] in northern Jundland, defeating multiple Sand People warriors along the way.<ref name="MT">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]|Militia Training|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>

The heroes took on an additional mission for militiamen [[Dak Williks]] and [[Jerol Nex]] to reduce attacks on local settlements by eliminating a number of Sand People warriors. At least sixteen Sand People were defeated by the heroes in order to protect the settlers.<ref name="ToR" />

Upon returning from the patrol, Galt received an emergency holocall from militiaman [[Cole Darba]] reporting an attack by unknown forces on the militia's [[Manister Base]]. Galt deployed Vastil and a squad of reserve recruits to scout the path to the base while the heroes followed.<ref name="MT" /> Arriving at the base, the heroes found Vastil and the militiamen pinned down by [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] forces who were also raiding the militia's supply depot. The heroes directed the remaining militia members to wait until they thinned the Geonosian ranks before slipping out of the base.<ref name="MiT">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]|Militia's Trial|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> To put a further stop to Geonosian attacks on Tatooine citizens, the heroes defeated several more of their fighters,<ref name="GW1">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Stage 1 - Geonosian War|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> destroyed eight of their supply crates,<ref name="GW2">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Stage 2 - Geonosian War|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> defeated five drone commanders,<ref name="GW3">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Stage 3 - Geonosian War|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> and defeated their legendary war marshal, [[Polarin]], and recovered defense data from his body.<ref name="GWF">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Final Stage - Geonosian War|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>

The Citizens' Militia reported that Geonosian raids on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] farms and settlements were being coordinated with coded signals. The militia circulated a message across its network terminals requesting assistance in obtaining the Geonosian signal device codes to decode the signals to help them prepare for future attacks. The Republic heroes accepted the mission and obtained the codes at Manister Base. They defeated at least ten Geonosians<ref name="StH">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Smash the Hive|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> before delivering the codes to militia [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Borik Sabha]].<ref name="BtC" />

===Outpost Largona missions===
Militia [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Jule (Tatooine)|Jule]] led a squad on a mission to slice Imperial [[Communications relay/Legends|communications relays]]. After the entire squad was killed in an ambush, Jule resolved to attempt to complete his unit's mission but became heavily inebriated at [[Outpost Largona]]. Seeing he was not fit to complete his mission, the Republic heroes took his [[Computer spike/Legends|data spike]] and sliced the four relays<ref name="QI">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]|Quality Insurance|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> while also defeating twenty Sand People preparing for a raid.<ref name="SaS">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Sand Storm|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>

The militia posted another message on its network notifying locals that [[Sorin Schaff]], the militia's main supporter, was being held prisoner in [[Schaff homestead|his own home]] by the Twin Suns. The militia was ill-equipped to handle the gang's leader, [[Braigin Helk]], and requested aid to defeat Helk and liberate Schaff. The four Republic heroes took on the mission, defeating at least sixteen gang members<ref name="DOTSP">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Drive Out Twin Suns Pirates|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> before taking down Helk himself and freeing Schaff.<ref name="PB">{{TORcite|type=heroic|Pirate Bullies|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>

About [[3641 BBY|two years later]],<ref name="3641BBY">{{TOR_dates|2}}</ref> the militia issued an advisory warning of an another increase in disappearances near the [[Outlaw's Den]] and cautioned travelers to avoid the area.<ref name="LS">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]|Lawless Sands|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Citizens' Militia first appeared in the [[BioWare]]-[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in [[2011]]. The organization was first mentioned by its proper name in the Republic faction mission [HEROIC 2+] Breaking the Code, accessible from a Citizens' Militia Network Terminal at Camp Karnori as part of the planetary bonus series.<ref name="BtC" /> In all previous Republic faction missions, the organization was referred to generally as the local militia. Non-player character members of this organization were easily distinguishable by their reddish-brown armor.<ref name="JG">{{TORcite|type=enemy|Junter Galt|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>
